start.title: 胎内の二つの国民
start.text:
あなたはヤコブです。生まれながらにしてエサウのかかとを掴みました。
彼は野を駆け巡り、あなたは天幕の中に留まります。

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Cook lentil stew at the tent
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] The pot bubbles. Red. Fragrant. The day is quiet.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Run after Esau into the open hills
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] The thorns tear your robe. The hunt is not yours.

hunt_consequence.title: あなたの畑ではない
hunt_consequence.text:
エサウは尾根から笑います。「家に帰れ、弟よ。
この野は私のものだ。」あなたは空っぽのまま引き返します。

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Return to the tents and cook
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Mother smiles. "The Lord's word is on the quiet ones."

the_stew.title: エサウ、飢えて帰る
the_stew.text:
エサウは飢えで気を失いそうになりながら、野からよろめき帰ってきます。
「早く—あの赤いものを少し飲ませてくれ！」

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Ask for the birthright in exchange
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Your voice is steady. "First sell me your birthright."

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Just give him the stew freely
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] He eats and leaves. The promise of Abraham passes you by.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Send him away — let him hunt his own
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] He curses and storms off. Mercy was the smaller test.

free_consequence.title: 扉が再び開く
free_consequence.text:
数日後、飢えが彼を再び駆り立てます。主の選びは
まだ、あなたの言葉を待っています。

choices.text: [TODO:ja] This time, ask for the birthright
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] He nods, weary. "Take it. What good is it to me?"

send_consequence.title: 彼が戻ってくる
send_consequence.text:
夕暮れ時、彼はより穏やかに、より飢えて戻ってきます。
二度目のチャンスが天幕の入り口を通ってやって来ます。

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Offer the stew for the birthright
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] "Swear to me first." The pot steams between you.

the_oath.title: "まず私に誓いなさい"
the_oath.text:
"見ろ、私はもうすぐ死ぬ。長子の権利が私に何の役に立つというのだ？"
彼の腕が鉢に伸びる。

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Make him swear before you give it
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] He swears. The birthright is yours. He eats. He leaves. He despises it.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Trust his word — hand him the bowl
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] He eats, laughs, walks out. Nothing was sealed but bread.

trust_consequence.title: 言葉は風
trust_consequence.text:
母はあなたを脇に呼ぶ。「封印されていない約束は、約束ではない。
彼が再び来たら、誓いで彼を縛りなさい。」

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Wait, and bind him with an oath next time
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Esau returns. This time, he swears. The birthright is yours.

stew_eaten.title: パン、シチュー、そして長子の権利
stew_eaten.text:
エサウは食べ、飲み、立ち上がり、去っていく。
こうして彼は長子の権利を軽んじた。歳月は流れる。

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Keep the secret and live quietly
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Years pass. Isaac grows old, his eyes dim with age.

isaac_old.title: イサク、エサウを呼ぶ
isaac_old.text:
父は老いた。彼の目は影しか見えない。彼はエサウを呼ぶ。
「私に獲物を狩ってきなさい。死ぬ前にあなたを祝福しよう。」

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Wait quietly — go to your mother Rebekah
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] She has heard everything. Her eyes are bright with purpose.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Confront Esau — demand the blessing now
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] He laughs. "You have my birthright. The blessing is mine."

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Walk away — the blessing is not for you
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Mother stops you at the door. "The Lord told me — the older shall serve the younger."

confront_consequence.title: 母、あなたを脇に呼ぶ
confront_consequence.text:
リベカはあなたを奥の天幕に引き入れる。
「まだ何もしてはいけない。聞きなさい、そして私の声に従いなさい。」

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Listen to your mother's plan
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] You sit. Her voice is low and certain.

walkaway_consequence.title: あなたの誕生の言葉
walkaway_consequence.text:
「二つの国民があなたの胎内にいる」と主は彼女に告げた。
「兄は弟に仕えるであろう。」彼女は覚えている。

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Listen to her plan
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] You bow your head. "Tell me what to do."

rebekah_plan.title: 「私の声に従いなさい」
rebekah_plan.text:
「私に若いヤギを二匹連れてきなさい。あなたの父が好む料理を作りましょう。
あなたは彼のところへ行き、祝福を受けるでしょう。」

choices.text: [TODO:ja] "But Esau is hairy, and I am smooth…"
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] She covers your arms with the kid-skins. "My son, let the curse fall on me."

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Refuse — the deception is too great
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] She holds your face. "The Lord has spoken. Do not turn back now."

refuse_blessing.title: 言葉は立つ
refuse_blessing.text:
「約束はあなたにある。主はあなたが生まれる前にそう言われた。
私の声に従いなさい、息子よ。ただ従いなさい。」

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Accept — let her dress you
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] The kid-skins are warm against your arms. Your heart pounds.

the_disguise.title: エサウの衣
the_disguise.text:
彼女はエサウの一番良い衣を持ってくる。それは野の香りがする。
子ヤギの皮があなたの手と滑らかな首を覆う。

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Take the dish and go to your father
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] The savory smell rises around you. You step toward the inner tent.

father_tent.title: 「あなたは誰だ、息子よ？」
father_tent.text:
イサクは盲目の顔を上げる。「誰だ？」
あなたの喉は乾いている。その瞬間が続く。

choices.text: [TODO:ja] "I am Esau your firstborn."
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] The words leave your lips. The tent holds its breath.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] "It is I, Jacob — forgive me."
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] He recoils. "Then leave me — go!" The blessing slips away.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Stay silent and offer the dish
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] "Speak, my son. Who are you?" There is no path forward without words.

confess_consequence.title: 戸口の母
confess_consequence.text:
リベカはあなたを引き戻す。「今がその時だ。エサウはすぐに戻る。
戻りなさい。私が教えた言葉を話しなさい。」

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Return and say, "I am Esau your firstborn."
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] You step back into the tent. Your father turns his head.

silent_consequence.title: 彼は再び尋ねる
silent_consequence.text:
「息子よ、話せ。誰だ？」
沈黙は保てない。

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Answer, "I am Esau your firstborn."
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] The words come. "I have done as you asked. Sit and eat."

the_test.title: 「近づいて、私に触らせなさい」
the_test.text:
イサクは震える手を伸ばす。
「声はヤコブだが、手はエサウだ。」

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Hold still and let him feel the kid-skins
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] His fingers pass over the rough hair. "Are you truly my son Esau?"

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Pull back — flee the tent
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Rebekah catches you outside. "Go back. The Lord's hand is on this hour."

flee_consequence.title: もう時間がない
flee_consequence.text:
エサウはすでに丘にいる。窓は閉まる。
「戻りなさい、息子よ。今すぐ。」

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Return and stand still
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] You enter again. He reaches out. You let him feel.

the_blessing.title: 祝福の言葉
the_blessing.text:
「神があなたに天の露と地の豊かさを与えられますように。
人々があなたに仕えますように。あなたを呪う者は呪われますように。」

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Receive the blessing and slip away
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] You bow. You leave. The tent flap falls behind you like a closing door.

esau_returns.title: エサウ、狩りから戻る
esau_returns.text:
天幕の外から彼の声が聞こえ、そして大きな叫び声がする。
「父よ、私をも、私をも祝福してください！」

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Listen, hidden behind the tent
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Isaac trembles. "Your brother came in deceit and took your blessing."

esau_wrath.title: 「兄を殺す」
esau_wrath.text:
エサウの声は火のように高まる。「父を悼む日々は
近い。その時、私はヤコブを殺すだろう。」

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Run to your mother
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] She is already waiting, her face pale. "Flee at once to my brother Laban."

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Confront Esau — beg his forgiveness
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] His knife is half-drawn. Mother pulls you back through the tent flap.

confront_esau_consequence.title: まだだ、今ではない
confront_esau_consequence.text:
リベカはあなたの顔を抱きしめる。「彼は今夜、あなたの声を聞かないだろう。
ハランへ行きなさい。私の兄のところへ。彼の怒りが収まるまで。」

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Go to your mother's plan
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] You bow. The night is wide. The road to Haran is far.

rebekah_warning.title: 「ハランへ逃げなさい」
rebekah_warning.text:
「兄の怒りが収まるまで、数日間ラバンと一緒にいなさい。
私があなたを呼び戻すでしょう。なぜ一日で二人とも失わなければならないのですか？」

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Pack lightly and slip out at dusk
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] She kisses your forehead. "The Lord be with you, my son."

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Refuse — you will not run
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] "Then you will die," she whispers. "And the promise dies with you."

refuse_flee_consequence.title: 約束は生きなければならない
refuse_flee_consequence.text:
彼女の握りは鉄のようだ。「主はあなたが生まれる前にあなたを選ばれた。
今夜逃げなさい。生きなさい。時が来たら戻りなさい。」

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Yield and prepare to leave
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] You gather a staff and a cloak. Nothing more.

isaac_sends.title: [TODO:ja] A Father's Last Word
isaac_sends.text:
[TODO:ja] Isaac calls you in. He lays his hand on your head once more.
"Take a wife from Laban's daughters. May God Almighty bless you."

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Bow, and set out alone toward Haran
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] The blessing is sealed. You step into the dusk with a staff in your hand.

the_road.title: [TODO:ja] The Long Road East
the_road.text:
[TODO:ja] Behind you — the tents of your father.
Ahead — Haran, and a stone for a pillow under a wide sky.
